evidence: polePredicate_sound is proved with no hypotheses, on [M]'s x+3l curves, for any prime p > 3 and any finite set of p-adic-unit multipliers. Its conclusion (odd v_p(B) implies v_p(B) >= 0) is [M]'s 'not negative and odd'. Applied to the signed divisors of 2730 it covers exactly p not in S_0, so it is more general. The step from Phi(B) (Arithmetic.pole) to polePredicate is not stated.

The Lean statement of polePredicate_sound has no hypothesis beyond p > 3, p-adic-unit multipliers and the pole branch on [M]'s x+3l curves, and its conclusion is [M]'s; for B != 0, Phi(B) is equivalent to polePredicate on the 64 signed divisors of 2730, so the generalization over M makes it stronger. The claim correctly records that [N] states no bridge from Phi to polePredicate.
